description: Branches open and update only from 02:00 to 09:59 UTC. Each push to a family branch runs the consumer's paid CI with a build, and about 50 releases a day reached each consumer as about three pushes a day; one window makes it about one. Set here, not in renovate-family.json, so it holds in every listed repo whether or not its renovate.json extends the preset. The window is 8 hours because GitHub starts the half-hourly cron only every 2.5 to 5 hours. Outside it, a run changes a branch only where someone ticked its box on the Dependency Dashboard or a PR.
